answer: Age in the trust hierarchy is bought with per-identity verified output rather than with elapsed time, so an operator cannot batch his accounts through a queue and must run each one through genuine, individually verified work. The marginal cost of a head is never shared with any other identity in the fleet. The dune is the attested output, the meadow the stranger who checks it, and the terrace the tier the pair unlocks; the dune is per identity, the meadow cannot be the farm's own, and the terrace is what waiting alone cannot buy. Each head also needs a stranger to attest that work.
